text: Aranalda is a follower of Azura. She is mentioned in Worn, Faded Note during the quest "Azura." Aranalda is the only archer in the party. Besides her bow, she also carries a leveled sword. She also has a 25% chance of wielding a staff.

Apronia Alfena is an Imperial commoner and the only survivor of the wrecked Supply Ship. The ship is located on the coast of the Isinfier Plains. The Nerevarine must then escort her back to Raven Rock. If she arrives safely then she will become a member of the colony.
Arbiter Salida at-Natedan is a Redguard residing in Leki's Blade, Hammerfell.
Apprentice Smith Roccan is a Redguard residing in Leki's Blade
Arantamo is a fellow prisoner in . He can be found on the northeastern section of the Outer Camp. He can train the Hero in Conjuration, Destruction, and Speechcraft.

Archers are the marksmen of Tamriel, adept at combat over great distances. Archers are able to take down most foes before they have a chance to draw their sword. Archers typically wear light armor and can use any weapon, although their weapons of choice tend to be the long bow and the short bow. Needing both hands for utilizing their weapons of choice, archers rarely carry shields. A high agility ensures accuracy in delivering their arrows, and a high strength ensures maximum penetration.

Archery is one of three offensive weapon-based skills in . The Archery skill is raised by and governs the use of bows and crossbows. Archery benefits from The Thief Stone (Though it appears under the warrior stone on the skill tree simply because it is the last thief stone affected skill on the warrior side, such as enchanting is on the mage side). Users of the skill, such as archers and hunters, are trained in the use of bows and arrows. The greater the skill, the more deadly the shot. Archery provides low health and lightly armored characters the means to engage foes from a safe distance and allows repeated sneak attacks.

The Imperial Arena is a faction in . It consists of the staff and color-coded Blue and Yellow teams that take part in the bloodsports hosted in the eponymous Arena District located in the eastern hemisphere of the Imperial City. The Hero of Kvatch may watch gladiatorial combats and bet on the outcome or join the Arena to climb the ranks themselves during the associated quest.

Arena Light Raiment is available from the Blademaster of the Arena, Owyn. If the Hero request light armor he will give them this raiment, which they must wear in their competitions in the arena, but any helmet, sword, and shield may be used.

The Arena Heavy Raiment is provided to the brave souls willing to participate as a combatant at the Imperial City Arena. The armor is mandatory for battling in the arena and will take the place of cuirass, boots, greaves, and gauntlets. Any helmet, weapon, and shield may be used.

Argonian Skeleton is a non-hostile undead skeleton that appears in . In life, he was Tsona-Ei, a sailor in the All Flags Navy. After his ship was sucked into Coldharbour, his captain struck a deal with Molag Bal that gave him a crown that allowed him to fully control his crew; the whole crew became skeletons because of this curse.
Arkasis's Genius is a dungeon set in . It is a Heavy Armor Hazardous Alchemy Style set, and can be found in Stone Garden.
Arm of the Moon is a weapon in that is a part of the Arms of Chaos Creation Club content.
Arm of the Sun is a weapon in that is a part of the Arms of Chaos Creation Club content.

The Argonian Fishing Rod is a tool and one-handed weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon Fishing. It is a variant of the regular Fishing Rod crafted by Argonians. It features a lizard head on top of the handle, exactly the Fang of Haynekthnamet.
Arvel the Swift is a Dunmer thief in who is found trapped in a spider web at Bleak Falls Barrow. Arvel wears a full set of hide armor. He is the primary antagonist of the quest "The Golden Claw."

The Armorer skill determines the effectiveness while trying to repair damaged weapons and armor. The Hero can increase the skill level by attempting to fix their own damaged equipment rather than taking it to a smith for repairs. Repairs attempted with the armorer skill are augmented by repair hammers. It returns in as a skill called Smithing. :Governing attribute: Endurance
The Armor of Tiber Septim is a cuirass that appears in the Main Quest of , originally worn by the late Tiber Septim. The armor has the appearance of an un-enchanted Imperial Dragon Cuirass.
Asbjorn Fire-Tamer is a Nord who lives in the city of Riften. He is an apprentice blacksmith to Balimund at The Scorched Hammer.

The Armor of the Old Gods is a unique light armor set. It is an enchanted set of Forsworn armor and is one of the two rewards that can be obtained for completing the quest "No One Escapes Cidhna Mine."
Armun-An Bonemold Left Pauldron is a piece of Medium Armor armor type in .
Armun-An Bonemold Right Pauldron is a piece of the Bonemold Armor set in .

Arver Rethul is a Dunmer who resides in Morrowind. Arver is a member of the Thieves Guild. For a price, he is willing to train in Long Blade, Block, and Athletics. Despite being a member of the Thieves Guild, he is located in the Camonna Tong headquarters, the guard house located in Dren Plantation.

Arrow is a large ship which can be found docked in the harbor of Dagon Fel in the Sheogorad region of Vvardenfell. It is owned by Haema Farseer. Haema offers transportation to the ports of Khuul, Sadrith Mora, Tel Aruhn and Tel Mora which are located around the north and northeast coasts of Vvardenfell. Like other transport ships in Vvardenfell, the Arrow may be used for smuggling, as implied by the pieces of contraband Raw Glass and Raw Ebony on the ship's lower deck.

An Armor Set is defined as a complete set of armor that includes one matching armor piece for the head, chest, hands and feet. There are several different armor sets available in , both in heavy and light variants. Certain armor sets can provide special bonuses if the full set is worn.
The Armory is a storage room in the Imperial City Prison District for the Imperial Legion's equipment. The Imperial Dragon Armor is found here after completing the main quest.
Armor Eater is a Destruction spell in that damages a victim's armor.

Armor Repair Debts is a House Redoran quest available to the Nerevarine, during the events of . Having successfully escorted Deval Beleth to Koal Cave, the Nerevarine will receive a new task from Tuveso Beleth.

Armor Apprentice is a Dunmer apprentice found in Sundercliff Forge during the Unearthing Mehrunes' Razor quest. He is standing on the upper level of the area by his forge not far from The Forgemaster. He uses heavy armor and a leveled weapon.
Arrow Spray is an active skill in the Bow skill line in . It is unlocked at Bow rank 20.

Arvys Avani is a Dunmer weaponsmith. He sells his wares at his stall, By The Sword, in the market district of Davon's Watch. He is a member of the Avani family, who are craftsmen by heritage. His father is Merail Avani, and his sister Durena Avani works as an armorer.
Armor of the Construct was a heavy item set in . It was renamed to Hatchling's Shell with Update 12.
Artaeum Armor and Vestments is a tailor's and leatherworker's shop located within the city of Haven. It is run by Caalore and Masna al-Satakalaam.
Armsmen are merchants in who specialize in armor and weapons. They are affiliated with the Fighters Guild, and can be found in branches throughout Tamriel. The following is a list of all armsmen:

Armor of the Trainee is an overworld item set located in Bal Foyen, Betnikh, Bleakrock Isle, Khenarthi's Roost and Stros M'Kai. Generic items can be found in the style corresponding to the location they were found in. Because this set can only be found in tutorial zones that do not have dungeons, world bosses or world events, pieces can only be acquired from treasure chests, Thieves Troves, and Psijic portals or as quest rewards.

Armorers are merchants in who specialize in heavy armor. They are typically found in cities and settlements, where they often sell their items either in stalls or over-the-counter. The following is a list of all Armorers:
Armor of Truth is an item set in . It is a Heavy Armor set, and can be obtained in Darkshade Caverns. Generic pieces appear in the Dark Elf Style.
Arms of Relequen is a Trial item set that appears in . It is a Welkynar style medium armor set obtained in Cloudrest.

Armor Rating is a type of resistance in . It is a measure of how effective a piece of armor is at absorbing and minimizing attacks. Armor reduces, but does not negate, the amount of physical damage received by 0.12% for each rating point, capping at a total of 80% negation, as well as a negligible amount of elemental damage.
Armorer's Tools are a series of tools used repair weapons and armor in .
The Armor Merchant is a merchant that can be found in Dragonstar West in .
Armor Collector is a character in that is a part of the Alternative Armors – Orcish Scaled Creation Club content.
Assemmus is a Dunmer scout living in Erabenimsun Camp. Assemmus is a member of the Ashlanders. He is also a minor trainer of the Athletics, Block and Long Blade skills.
Astante is an Altmer farmer living in the Brindle Home settlement in her house, north of Skingrad. She is seen carrying a two-handed battle axe, and may have a large sum of gold that can be looted.
Assamanut Sonnerralit is a Dunmer scout who resides in the Morrowind Ashlands. While hostile to anyone he sees, he can train anybody who calms him in Athletics, Block and Long Blade.

Assured Balanced Armor is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of the Medium Armor skill. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends. The magnitude is the value of the increase in the skill.

Assured Deep Biting is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of the Axe skill. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends. The magnitude is the value of the increase in the skill.

Assured Hewing is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of the Long Blade skill. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends. The magnitude is the value of the increase in the skill.

Assured Impaling Thrust is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of the Spear skill. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends. The magnitude is the value of the increase in the skill.

Assured Martial Craft is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of the Armorer skill. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends. The magnitude is the value of the increase in the skill.

Assured Nimble Armor is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of the Light Armor skill. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends. The magnitude is the value of the increase in the skill.

Assured Stolid Armor is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of the Heavy Armor skill. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends. The magnitude is the value of the increase in the skill.

Assured Swiftblade is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of the Short Blade skill. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends. The magnitude is the value of the increase in the skill.
Assassin's Blade is a Nightblade active skill in the Assassination skill line in . It is unlocked at Assassination rank 1.

Ashen Grip is a crafted item set in . The Vestige must have researched any two traits in the type of armor, weapon or jewelry that they wish to craft in the Ashen Grip set. The chapter is required to craft jewelry of this set.
Ashvorn Bear-Walker is a Nord patron of the Riverside Inn, in Nimalten.

Assured Smiting is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of the Blunt Weapon skill. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends. The magnitude is the value of the increase in the skill.
Aspect of Mazzatun is an item set that appears in . It is a Heavy Armor set, and can be found in Ruins of Mazzatun. It was added with the release of Update 11.

Assaulting the Citadel is a quest available in . Kailstig the Axe tells a group of delvers about Hel Ra Citadel, an ancient Yokudan city lost to the centuries. The city has recently been opened and occupied by the Celestial Warrior and drew to it several types of people; Redguards pilfering stones to retrieve pieces of their ancestral home, traders looking for a fabled freeway that once passed through the Citadel, and Undaunted which came after rumors of their disappearances.

Ashur of the Quiet Blade is a Dunmer residing in Balmora, on Vvardenfell. Ashur is an old friend of Naryu Virian and is a member of the Morag Tong. He helps Veya Releth during her investigation of Ulran Releth's death. He can later be found in Hakoshae in Northern Elsweyr investigating the town’s leader.
Assassin's Journal is a book in that is a part of the Bow of Shadows Creation Club content.

Auriel's Bow is a legendary artifact of Tamriel, granted by Anui-El to Auri-El, who wielded it in an equally legendary battle during the Dawn Era. The bow's mystical power is linked directly to the sun, with the sun itself being a direct link to Aetherius.

Auriel's Shield is an almost mythical artifact of Tamriel. Its origins lay in its creation, when Anui-El created the Shield on behalf of Auri-El, who later wielded it in his battle against Lorkhan during the Dawn Era.

Axe is a combat specialization skill in . The Axe skill determines the player's effectiveness when fighting with weapons of this type. Axe is governed by the Strength attribute. There are two primary types of weapons governed by this skill: one-handed (war axe) and two-handed (battle axe). One-handed weapons are generally lighter and faster, and do less damage, but allow the use of a shield granting greater protection. Two-handed are generally heavier and slower, and do more damage, but prevent the use of a shield thereby sacrificing protection. The skill level is increased while wielding this weapon during combat. When a strike lands successfully, progress towards the skill increase a percentage. When the progression of the current skill level reaches 100%, the skill level increases by 1.
An axe is a one- or two-handed weapon having either a single blade, or a double blade attached to the main grip. The effectiveness of using an axe is governed by the Blunt skill.

The Ayleid Crown of Nenalata is an ancient elven helmet with a Reflect Spell and two fortify enchantments. The enchantments are leveled, so they vary depending on the level of the Hero when they obtain the item.

The Ayleid Crown of Lindai is an ancient Elven Helmet with a Resist Magic and two fortify enchantments. The enchantments are leveled, so they vary depending on what level the Hero was when the crown was obtained. If Umbacano wears this crown in Nenalata, it will lose all of its armor value and enchantments.
The Ayleid Long Sword is a unique Elven Longsword in , that can only be encountered during "The Ultimate Heist." When trying to take the weapon, it will crumble.

Axe of Whiterun is one of a unique group of weapons found in . This weapon is one of several Thane weapons awarded after becoming Thane of the respective hold. It can either be a blade or an axe, though both are similar in many ways.
Axe of Eastmarch is a semi-unique weapon in . This weapon is one of several Thane weapons awarded after becoming Thane of a hold in Skyrim.
The Ayleid Mace is a Blunt weapon in . It is a modified form of the Elven Mace. It is one of the rarest weapons in the game, although its base damage is similar to the Elven Mace.
Axe-Fist is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild found in the hall of Stormhold.
Axe and Bridle is a stable in the Morkul Stronghold run by the Orsimer stablemaster Duragma.
Ayleids' Coat of Memories is a piece of heavy armor in rewarded to the Vestige upon completion of the quest "Light from the Darkness."
Automated Defense is a trial set in . It was introduced in Update 14, with the release of . It is a Medium Armor set acquired from the Halls of Fabrication. Pieces are in the Refabricated Style.
Automated Defense Bow is a bow in which may be obtained from the Fabricant's Shining Coffer after completing the quest "Forging the Future" on veteran difficulty.

The Axe of the Lunar Bastion is an axe in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Axe may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Axe is a part of the Lunar Bastion item set.

The Axe of Alkosh is an axe in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Axe may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Axe is a part of the Roar of Alkosh item set.

The Axe of Twilight Remedy is an axe in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Axe may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Axe is a part of the Twilight Remedy item set.
Auroran's Thunder is a dungeon set in . It is a Light Armor Meridian Style set, and can be found in Depths of Malatar.
Azarain's Journal is a journal in that is part of the Vigil Enforcer Armor Set Creation Club content.

Baleni Salavel is a Dunmer shipmaster living in Hla Oad. She can be found at docks and provides transportation services aboard her ship, Harpy. Baleni also engages in other activities; she has quite a stash of illegal substances such as Moon Sugar aboard her ship.

Balimund is a Nord blacksmith living in Riften. He works at The Scorched Hammer located near the marketplace. Balimund opens up shop as soon as he kneels to work on the Tanning Rack at 7:30 AM. There are stacks of iron/steel ingots that respawn once a month in his house's basement.
Balgruuf's War Axe is a unique war axe and a quest item used in the quest "Message to Whiterun."

Baissa is a Khajiit trader who set up general goods shop in the Upper Waistworks of the Foreign Quarter in Vivec City. She buys weapons, armor, books, clothing, alchemy ingredients, lights, repair tools, enchanted items, potions and various clutter. She has a base barter sum of 100 and is also one of the traders who buys Moon Sugar and Skooma.
Azra's Staffs is a quest in in which the Dragonborn is asked by Neloth to recover a staff belonging to Azra Nightwielder.
Baleful Glower is an Illusion spell that increases the caster's chance of evading physical attacks. This includes hand-to-hand combat and melee or ranged weapons, but has no affect on magic.
Balanced Warrior is a Templar passive ability in the Aedric Spear skill line in .
Balanced Blade is a passive skill in the Two Handed skill line in .
The Azra's Mace is a weapon found in , it is a weapon of Azra Nightwielder, the first shadowmage.

Azzin is a Redguard residing in the Town. He is a dragon hunter and former Blade. He found the Fugitive and challenged him to a fight in the arena. After the duel he revealed himself, and invited the Fugitive to help him kill dragons.
Azureblight Reaper is a dungeon set in . It can be obtained from Lair of Maarselok. It is a Medium Armor set, and items are in the Stags of Z'en Style.

Intelligent and personable, Bards prefer to accomplish tasks with their words first, and sword second. Bards are travelling storytellers, singers, dancers and all around performers. Bards are able to perform many tasks, including but not limited to weapons skills, picking locks and pockets, and magic. Extremely versatile, Bards typically carry a wide variety of weapons, and are capable of using many types of armors and shields. Bards are also extremely adept at delivering blows that render the highest level of damage to their opponents.
The Banded Iron Shield is part of a heavy armor set found in . It is slightly stronger than the regular Iron Shield, but requires more materials to craft.

Bargain Lightning Shield is the lowest quality potion available that creates a shield of elemental lightning around the user's body, increasing resistance to Shock Damage and inflicting a small amount of damage upon nearby adversaries.

Bargain Potion of Fire Shield is the lowest quality potion available that creates a shield of elemental fire around the user's body, increasing resistance to Fire Damage and inflicting a small amount of damage upon nearby adversaries.

Bargain Potion of Frost Shield is the lowest quality potion available that creates a shield of elemental frost around the user's body, increasing resistance to Frost Damage and inflicting a small amount of damage upon nearby adversaries.

Barirrid is a Nord Barbarian residing in the Daedric Shrine of Tusenend in the Molag Amur region. He has no unique dialogue and wears Nordic Fur Armor. As he and the other occupants of the shrine are Daedra worshippers, he will attack the Nerevarine on sight. He is accompanied by three other worshippers in the Shrine: the Dunmer Gils Oril, the Orsimer Nargol gra-Uftharz, and the fellow Nord Val, all of whom are Barbarians except for Oril, who is a Battlemage.
A Bandit Outlaw is a stronger variant of a bandit. They are commonly found with normal bandits, but may have better weapons or armor; for instance, a steel sword rather than an iron one.

Bandit Highwaymen are high-ranking Bandits. They usually wear better armor than their Bandit comrades and wield better weapons. They carry higher-quality loot and are usually accompanied by lower level Bandits like the common Outlaw or Thug. Bandit Highwaymen are encountered after the Dragonborn has reached level 14.
Baron Sorick's Pauldrons is a heavy armor shoulder equipment received after completing the quest "The Sower Reaps."
Bandit Gloves are a piece of light magic armor in , it grants +2 lockpicking to those who wear it.

Barid Dark-Sword is a Nord found in Koeglin Village. Upon arrival, he can be found on the docks. However, he seems to disappear from the village entirely after the quest "False Accusations" has been completed. He has no unique dialogue.
Baro Storm-Blade is a Nord patron of the Cold Moon Inn in Windhelm.
Basks-In-Darkness is a patron of the Ship's Hold Inn, in Alten Corimont.
Barkskin is an item set in . It is a Medium Armor set, and can be found in Elden Hollow.
Bani's Torment is a dungeon set in . It is a Heavy Armor Icereach Coven Style set, and can be found in Icereach.

The Battle of Hattu Mountain was a battle between the Sword-Singers, led by Frandar Hunding, and the forces of Hira. The battle resulted in over 300,000 deceased, and fewer than 20,000 Sword-Singers survived, though victorious.

Battlemage is a class in various games. They commonly focus on combat using both magic spells, as well as blunt and blade weapons. Battlemages are a deadly mix of scholar and soldier, and are trained to utilize offensive spells during combat. In such situations, battlemages have few equals. These adventurers prefer to remain on the offensive and dispatch a target quickly rather than waiting on their opponent to make a mistake. They are also capable alchemists that use potions and poisons to give them an extra edge in battle.
The Battleaxe of Hatred is an enchanted Battle Axe in . It has three different Damage enchantments.
The Battle Axe of Enfeeblement is an enchanted Dwarven Battle Axe in with a Damage Endurance enchantment.
The Battlehorn Castellan is a replacement if Castellan Athon is killed. He wears full Steel Armor and also has a Shield of True Horn.
Baurin is a Bosmer Scout who resides in the Fighters Guild in the Foreign Quarter Plaza in Vivec City. She is a minor trainer in Medium Armor, Block and Sneak.
Baurus's Akaviri Katana is a unique Akaviri Katana wielded by Baurus, a member of the Blades.

Battlehorn Man-At-Arms are soldiers who fight to defend the Battlehorn Castle from four Marauders: one warlord, one battlemage, one archer and one fighter. The Hero can assist the men at arms and, if successful, receive the castle itself. They wear leveled heavy armor and are melee fighters. After the fight, the surviving men-at-arms will stay patrolling the castle, both inside and out.
Battlefield Mobility is a passive skill in the One Hand and Shield skill line in .
Bastion of the Dragon is a shield the Vestige receives after completing the quest "The Nameless Soldier."
Bastion of the Heartland is an item set in . It is a Heavy Armor set.
Beckoning Steel is an item set in . It is a Heavy Armor set. Pieces are in Alliance styles. It can be obtained in Cyrodiil from merchants or daily quests.
Beekeeper's Gear is an overland set in . It was added with the release of One Tamriel. It can be obtained in Greenshade. It is a Heavy Armor set in the Khajiit Style.

The Battle Axe of the Lunar Bastion is a battle axe in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Battle Axe may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Battle Axe is a part of the Lunar Bastion item set.

The Battle Axe of Alkosh is a battle axe in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Battle Axe may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Battle Axe is a part of the Roar of Alkosh item set.

The Battle Axe of Twilight Remedy is a battle axe in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Battle Axe may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Battle Axe is a part of the Twilight Remedy item set.
Battlefield Acrobat is an item set in . It can be obtained from Rewards for the Worthy mail, and is a Medium Armor set.
Battalion Defender is an item set in . It can be obtained from Rewards for the Worthy mail, and is a Heavy Armor set.
Beldama Witch's Note is a note in that is a part of the Spell Knight Armor Creation Club content.
Belos Falos is a Dunmer Thief, and member of the Camonna Tong and medium Skill trainer who resides in Vivec, Hlaalu Canton. He can train the Nerevarine in Short Blade, Light Armor, and Security.
Beveled Gauntlets is a type of glass armor found in . It has an enchantment of Detect Life 105 on self.
Belt of Sanguine Balanced Armor is an enchanted extravagant belt in .
Belt of Sanguine Martial Craft is an enchanted extravagant belt in .
Belt of Sanguine Stolid Armor is an enchanted extravagant belt in .
Belt of the Armor of God is a unique belt that is enchanted with a variety of defensive magic effects that increase the wearer's armor rating, chance to dodge melee attacks, and resistance to magic.
Berserker Silver Longsword is a one-handed silver in . This leveled long blade can be obtained by killing the Nord Berserkers that are found throughout Solstheim.
Binder's Robe is a piece of light armor in . It is a reward for completing the quest "A Village Awakened."
Betina's Fashionable Gloves are light armor gauntlets found in . They are a quest reward for completion of the quest "Vengeance of the Oppressed."
Berserking Warrior is a trial set in . It is a Heavy Armor Celestial Style set, and can be found in Hel Ra Citadel. Items in this set are called Advancing Yokeda.
Berserker Strike is a Weapon-Skill Ultimate that was introduced into as of Update 12.

The Black Bow Bandit is a bandit archer belonging to the Black Bows faction. There are eight variations of the Black Bow Bandit: four males and four females. They all wear light armor and wield daggers.

Black Hand Robes are powerful enchanted robes reserved for members of the Black Hand. Compared with Shrouded Armor, they are heavier, offer no Armor protection, and have a Speechcraft enchantment instead of Acrobatics. However, the enchantments are stronger, totaling 15 points for each Skill when the Robes and Hood are worn together, as opposed to the Shrouded Armor's 10.
Black Bows are a type of bow exclusively wielded by the Black Bow Bandits in .
The Birthright of Astalon is an enchanted Elven armor cuirass in .
Black Rock Captain is the ghost of the captain of a ship that is in the hidden zone of Black Rock Caverns.

Black Bow Ringleader is a bandit boss for the Black Bow Bandits. There are three males and three females. They wield leveled weapons and wear leveled armor and each of them have either a potion of paralyze or drain health.
Blackguard's Armor is a unique piece of light armor and part of the Blackguard's Armor set found in .
Blackguard's Boots are a unique piece of light armor and part of the Blackguard's Armor set found in Raven Rock in Solstheim .
Blackguard's Gloves are a unique piece of light armor and part of the Blackguard's Armor set found in Raven Rock on the island of Solstheim.
The Blackguard's Hood is a unique piece of light armor and part of the Blackguard's Armor set.
Black Dart is a poisoned throwing weapon that is used by the Black Dart Gang in the Old Mournhold Temple Sewers.
Birdmaster Dehanar is a powerful Redguard fighter found at the Rahni'Za, School of Warriors.
Bjoulsae Queen Deckhand is a generic Breton sailor of the Bjoulsae Queen, a ship in Evermore.

Blade is a combat arts skill that determines a character's effectiveness with blade-type weapons, such as one-handed swords or dual-handed claymores. Weapons under the Blade category include both short and long blades. One can increase their skill level by using Blade-type weapons. This is highly recommended for most classes, as blades are commonly found throughout Cyrodiil and effective at close range. :Governing attribute: Strength

The Blade of Woe is a unique Ebony Dagger received from Lucien Lachance at the start of the quest "A Knife in the Dark". Lucien will explain that the dagger has never been used before, and gives it as a gift from the Dark Brotherhood. After the quest "Honor Thy Mother", the Night Mother will place a leveled enchantment on it. If Lachance is killed by the Hero of Kvatch in "A Knife in the Dark", the blade will no longer be a quest item. Instead, it will have a weight of 1, a selling price of 20 , and have a base damage of 3. __TOC__
Blackwood Armor is a variant of Steel Armor which is crafted for high-ranking members of the Blackwood Company.

Blades Armor is the Heavy Armor worn by the Blades, an organization charged with the protection of the Emperor. This full set of armor can be acquired for free by joining the Blades at Cloud Ruler Temple, just north of Bruma.
The Blackwater Blade is a leveled Fine Steel Longsword found on Selene, the leader of the Blackwater Brigands.
Blazing Spear is a journeyman-level Destruction spell in . It inflicts 35 points of fire damage on a target upon impact.
The Blades Helmet is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Blades Armor set found in .
The Blades Shield is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Blades Armor set found in .
Blades Boots are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Blades Armor set found in .
Blades Gauntlets are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Blades Armor set found in .

Blackwood Cuirass is a type of armor worn by the Blackwood Company, as part of the Blackwood Armor set.

Blacksmiths can be found in most cities and towns in Skyrim. Blacksmiths serve as merchants that specialize in weapons and armor, including enchanted pieces. They also sell various smithing materials, such as ores, ingots, leather and leather strips. Blacksmiths will only buy weapons, armor and smithing materials, unless the Merchant perk in the Speech skill tree is active. They typically carry more gold than most merchants, usually over 1000 even without any investment in the speech tree, making it ideal to sell all weaponry and armor to them first. Between 8 AM and 8 PM, they can usually be found near the town or city's smithing stations, either standing in one place or using one of the stations. The following Blacksmiths are female: Adrianne Avenicci, Gharol, Ghorza gra-Bagol, Hestla, and Shuftharz. The following Blacksmiths are male: Alvor, Arnskar Ember-Master †, Asbjorn Fire-Tamer, Balimund, Baldor Iron-Shaper , Beirand, Dushnamub, Elrindir, Eorlund Gray-Mane, Fihada, Filnjar, Glover Mallory , Gunmar , Lod, Moth gro-Bagol, Oengul War-Anvil, Rustleif, Syndus †, Ulfberth War-Bear, and Vanryth Gatharian †.

Blunt Weapon is a combat specialization skill in . This skill determines the player's effectiveness when using certain weapons. Blunt Weapon skill is governed by the strength attribute. There are two primary types of weapons governed by this skill: one-handed and two-handed. One-handed weapons are generally lighter and faster, and do less damage, but allow the use of a shield granting greater protection. Two-handed are generally heavier and slower, and do more damage, but prevent the use of a shield thereby sacrificing protection. Examples of one-handed blunt weapons are, clubs and maces. Two-handed weapons are warhammers and staves. The Blunt Weapon skill increases while using a blunt weapon during combat. When a strike lands successfully, progress towards the skill increase a percentage. When the progression of the current skill level reaches 100%, the skill level increases by 1.
